CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
